title: An approach to measuring the performance of Automatic Speech Recognition(ASR) models in the context of Large Language Model(LLM) powered applications
reasoning: The paper is entirely focused on a technical evaluation framework for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) outputs within Large Language Model (LLM) applications. It proposes a new metric called Answer Error Rate (AER) and evaluates technical performance across several ASR models and datasets; it contains no evaluation or analysis of religious, faith-based, moral, or ethical topics.
